(317)༄༅/ /thig le bcu drug gi sgom bzlas nyams su len tshul snying por dril ba bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (317)༄༅// thig le bcu drug gi sgom bzlas nyams su len tshul snying por dril ba bzhugs so/// /

(318)༄༅// mnyam med jo bo yab sras 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// byang chub bar du rjes su bzung du gsol/ /de'ang thig le bcu drug gi nyams len snying por dril te lag tu blangs pa'i tshul ni/ lha chos bdun ldan gyi rnal 'byor las gsung rab mtha' dag gi nyams len thig le bcu drug tu 'du ba dang*/ de rjes dran lngar 'du zhing*/ de'ang bsdu na thabs shes gnyis su 'du bar gsungs pas rjes dran lnga'i gdams pa ni rje btsun sgrol mas stsal ba yin te/ na ོ ra bu'i phreng ba'i le'u gnyis pa las/ sras kyi thu bo spyan ras gzigs/ /khyed kyi rjes 'brang kho mos bskyang*/ /kho mo'i gdams pa 'di longs la/ /rjes su 'brangs la bsten par gyes// skyabs gnas bla ma dran par mdzod// lus ni lha yi rang bzhin te/ /ngag ni bzlas brjod rgyun par mdzod/ /'gro ba ma lus pha mar soms/ /sems kyi gnas lugs stong par dpyod / /lnga po 'di yi skya bar gnas/ /dge rtsa thams cad dag par mdzod/ / ces gsungs pa de yin la/ 'di'i thog mthar sbyor rgyu gnyis kyang snga ma'i 'phro de ma thag tu/ de yi sngon tu gzungs 'di sbyar ro/ /bye ba 'gyur du rgyal bas gsungs/ /sras mchod de ni 'di lta ste/ /oṃ sambhā ra sambhā ra bi ma (319)na sa ba ma hā dzambha ba hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sras kyi thu bo deng yang nyon// de yi gong du spel byed yon// sgyur bar byed pa bsngo ba mchog /dus gsum dge rtsa mchog bsags pa// mchog rab mchog gi lam nyid la// mchog gi sems kyi mchog tu bsngo// de ni sgyur byed bsngo ba yin// zhes thun gyi mgor 'gyur sngags bzla ba dang*// mjug tu bsngo ba byed tshul bcas gsungs so/ /yang de'ang thabs shes gnyis sam zab rgyas kyi lam gnyis su bsdus te nyams su len tshul le'u nyi shu pa las/ ngas chos thams cad hril te dril ba zhig khyod la sbyin/

bdag thongs gzhan longs 'od gur bzhugs// snang stong gzhi chod ngo bos stong*// dpyad nas ma rnyed lam du song*// lam de mi ldog pa yin no// gnas lugs tshad med rgyud la dril// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas chod// ces pa nas/ snang ba'i thabs kyis 'gro ba drongs// shes rab dbyings su gzims la bzhugs/ /dril te dril na 'di nyid yin// zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bka' gdams glegs bam gyi snying po'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i bum bzang du gsungs bzhin yin te/ mdor bsdu na stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can las ma 'das pas 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor nyid yin no// 'dir (320) rjes dran lnga'i chings dang sbyar te nyams su len pa la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs par bsam te/ 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa bcom ldan 'das// gangs ri'i mgon po rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// rgyal yum sgrol ma bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon// bka' gdams lha mchog bzhi la gsol ba 'debs// byams pa thogs med dbyig gnyen rnam grol sde// mchog sde dul ba'i sde dang grags pa'i sde// seng bzang ku sā li gnyis gser gling pa// rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud par gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dbyangs yod med phyogs 'jigs klu sgrub dang*// zla ba grags pa rig pa'i khu byug che// sangs rgyas dgongs skyong 'phags pa yab sras te// zab mo lta ba'i brgyud par gsol ba 'debs// thugs rje chen po bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang*// mchog gzigs tai lo pa dang nā ro pa// dpal mchog ḍombhi pa dang a ti sha/ nyams len byin rlabs brgyud par gsol ba 'debs// lam bzang gsal mdzad mgon po a ti sha/ bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes po rgyal ba 'brom// legs pa'i shes rab rgyal mtshan bzhi la sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// srid la zhen log rkyen ngan grogs su shar// bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i rlabs chen spyod la zhugs// sred rtsa drung 'byin lta bas rgyas btab ste// thun mong lam bzang bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// gsang sngags sgor zhugs dam tshig tshul bzhin srung*// zab gsal gnyis med lha yi rnal 'byor gyis// zung 'jug snying gi thig le mngon gyur nas// 'gro kun mgon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// sangs rgyas chos tshogs

ma tshar gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la skyabs yul rnams rim gyis bsdus te rang la thim par bsam/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po phyag gnyis (321)pa nor bu'i phreng ba dang shel gyi 'khar ba sangs rgyas stong gis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i skur gyur/ mchod pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod pa'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur/ oṃ ārghaṃ nas sparshe ā hūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlab/ 'od gsal stong pa'i dbyings las sems kyi mdangs// 'ja' tshon gur nang pad dkar lte ba la// steng dang phyogs bzhi 'og rnams yig drug gi /rang bzhin gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus// hrīḥlas bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// rgyal ba rgya mtsho phyag stong spyan stong ldan// mtha' klas rgyal ba'i zhing kun sku la gnas// sprul pa'i gar gyis mkha' mnyam 'gro ba 'dren// de yi thugs kar stong gsum mi mjed kyi// thig le sngar dang mtshungs pa'i gzhal yas dbus// thub chen rnam snang skyabs sbyin mnyam bzhag can// theg gsum 'phags tshogs mchog zung bcas te bzhugs// gsum pa kha ba can gyi thig le yi// gzhal yas dbus su 'phags mchog bcu gcig zhal// gnas khang thig ler 'phags mchog phyag gnyis pa// sangs rgyas stong gi mtshan pa'i 'khar ba bsnams// de yi thugs kar yum chen phyag bzhi ma// skyabs sbyin mnyam bzhag rdo rje glegs bam 'dzin// de nang bdud 'dul thub pa'i dbang po ni// sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor// thig le bdun par 'phags mchog phyag bzhi pa// rtsa phyag thal sbyar shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin// thugs kar rgyal yum sgrol ma ma rgad mdog /phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon pas utpal bsnams// de nang (322)sgrol ma ljang nag drag mo'i gzugs// gri thod ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin// thig le bcu par khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon// g.yon gyi pus btsugs ral gri zhags pa 'dzin// thugs kar rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can// jo bo chen por lha bzhi sogs kyis bskor// de nang 'brom rje pad dkar dril bu bsnams// phyi nang gsang gsum sprul pa'i tshogs bcas bzhugs// thig le bcu gsum pa la byams pa mgon// steng du rgya chen spyod brgyud tshogs bcas dang*// de yi thugs kar mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs// thab mo lta ba'i bla ma brgyud par bcas// 'jam mgon thugs kar khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor// de nang chos sku zag med ye shes dngos// rnam pa longs sku mnyam bzhag phyag rgya can// chos dbyings ngang las 'gro don mkha' khyab tu// mdzad pa'i snying dbus byang chub thig le ni// khyon yangs gsal 'tsher dbus su rang gi sems// thig le ser po 'od 'bar rgya sran tsam// mer mer 'jug zhing shin tu rgyas pa yi// btso ma'i gser mdog thig le'i rgya mtshor gyur// kun gyi gnas gsum yi ge gsum mtshan pa'i// hūm̐ yig 'od kyis zhing khams rab 'byams nas// ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs te// bstim zhing dbang bskur sa bon gyis mtshan gyur/

/de nas gzhal yas khang thams cad kyai sgo gcig car phye ste so sor yan lag bdun pa dang mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ phyag dang phyag yul gnyis stong pa'i// rnam dag sku la ye phyag 'tshal// skye gnas 'jigs pas ma gos pa'i// dri med mchod tshogs 'bul lo lha// sgo gsum skye gnas 'jig bral ba'i// nyes pa'i g.yang sa mthol lo bshags// stong yang sna tshogs skur ston pas// gangs med 'dren la rjes yi rang*// smon dang mtshan (323)mas stong pa yi// 'khor lo dbyings su bskor du gsol// skye bas stong pa'i chos sku khyed// lhun grub gnas pa'i rang bzhin las// gang du'ang 'da' bar ma mdzad cig /dge ba 'di yis 'khor ba rnams// 'di 'drar rtogs te 'di 'dra ba'i// gzhal yas khang du 'drengs 'gyur te// gsang sngags 'di bzhin spyod par bsngo// gnas skabs kri ya'i lha lnga bzhin// pad dkar stong ldan lte ba la// zla ba zhun ma'i gdan steng du// phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyi// bskyed rdzogs mchog tu bsngags par shog /glo bur 'di yang chos dbyings las// tha dad ci yang yod ma mchis// tha dad med par phun tshogs pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /gtsang ma rigs kyi bkra shis shog /thog mtha' bar gsum gtsang ma las// g.yos pa med pa'i bkra shis shog /ces yan lag bdun pa dbul/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i// zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mchod pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs// yon tan rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// dad pa rgya mtshos 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /zhes sogs tshig bcad dang sbrag pa'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pādyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dyā/ shabda/ rū pa/ shabda/ gandhe/ rā sa/ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon lnga rnams dbul/ rab 'byams rgyal dang rgyal sras rgyal ba'i yum// rgyal ba'i bstan srung kun 'dus lha mchog bzhi// mi yi rnam rol jo bo yab sras sogs// bslu med skyabs mchog rnams la gus pas bstod// khyad par chos sku'i snying por thabs shes zung*// thig le'i rnam par shar la bdag bstod na// lha chos bdun gyi snying khu thig le'i bcud// tshe 'dir mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/

/de nas yang*/ rang thugs rje chen po phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par logs su (324)phye bas sna drangs te ma gyur sems can thams cad kyis rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs phyi ma rnams la phyag dang bskor ba byas te gsol ba btab/ khyad par rang gi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs thams cad kyang 'gro ba mgon dang skyabs med pa rnams la phan pa dang bde ba'i rgyu gang la gang 'tshams kyi nyer 'tsho'i rten du 'gyur ba'i phyir lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa'i sprin dang bcas te phul bas zag med kyi bde bas dgyes/ gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum dang khyad par thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs nas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob/ thugs ka phyed nas nang ma nang mar phyag dang skor ba mchod pa sogs gong bzhin byas pas thams cad kyi byin rlabs thob par bsams la/ sa ོ so'i sngags sgrub dkyil rnams su 'byung ba ltar bzla ba'am/ thams cad la yig drug bzlas kyang chog par bka' gdams glegs bam gyi cha lag tu gsungs/ der ma zad thugs rje chen po'i sku'i ba spu'i bu ga rer yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs tshul / yi ge drug pa'i bzlas brjod byed tshul zab shos la dmigs rnam 'di 'dra zhig dgos tshul za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo la zhib tu brtags na gsal zhing*/ mgon po gser gling pas kyang de ltar gsungs yod pas bzlas pa yig drug gcig pur rtsal 'don byas na legs la/ thig le thams cad kyi nang du bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis phyag mchod sogs dus mnyam du byed pa'i dmigs pa bskyangs na'ang chog go /de nas lhag chad bskang ba'i phyir yig brgya ci mang bzla/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ brgyud pa gsum ldan bla ma thams cad dang*// yi dam thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs dang*// jo bo yab sras thugs rje can rnams kyis// bdag gi smon pa'i gnas 'di 'grub par mdzod// (325)'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs bsdoms pa'i mthus// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// brgyud pa gsum ldan bla ma dam pa yis// tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes bzung ste// bka' gdams rnam thar gtsang ma mthar phyin shog

/skyes bu gsum gyi lam du gsung rab kun// bsdus te nyams su blangs pas rgyud sbyangs nas// gsang chen sgor zhugs dam tshig tshul bzhin srung*// zung 'jug snying gi thig le 'grub par shog /lha bzhis lus dang sde snod gsum gyis ngag /bslab pa gsum gyis sems brgyan rjes dran lnga'i// nyams len mthar phyin 'gro kun sgrol ba la// rgyal ba rgya mtsho nyid dang mtshungs par shog /gsang chen snying gi thig le'i gdams pa mchog /dben pa'i gnas su nyams su len pa la// jo bo'i bka' srung dgu bcu rtsa gnyis kyis// g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs byed shog /rang gi thugs ka'i byang chub kyi thig le'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud mtha' dag bsdus te phyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thig le la thim/ thig le phyi ma bco lnga po rang rang gi gtso bo'i mdog can gyi thig le'i rnam par gyur te nang ma nang ma la thim zhing*/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'ang yi ge gsum dang*/ de'i oṃ āḥl thim/ āḥhūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ byang chub kyi thig le la thim ste thabs shes zung 'jug gi ngo bor gyur/ de'i ngang las slar yang thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur// legs tshogs kun gyi 'byung gnas bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sku gsum mngon du gyur pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi bkra shis shog /thog mtha' bar du dge ba dam pa'i chos kyi bkra shis shog /bslab gsum rnam par dag pa dge 'dun rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bdag gzhan mnyam (326)rje rin chen byang chub sems kyi bkra shis shog /thabs shes zung 'jug rim gnyis rnal 'byor zab mo'i bkra shis shog /phan bde'i gzhir gyur thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /'gro kun theg mchog chos kyi dpal la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// gsung rab don gyi dgongs pa'i mthil// jo bo yab sras thugs kyi bcud// snying gi thig le'i rnal 'byor gyis// 'gro kun smin cing grol gyur cig

/ces thig le bcu drug gi bsgom bzlas nyams su len tshul snying por dril ba 'di ni mang du thos pa'i don yang dag pa sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i ri khrod pa yon tan rgya mtshos bskul ngor// btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /sarba maṅga lam/// /
